besluite.fout: The two places being compared are introduced unevenly ('waar ...' against 'daar waar ...'), so the comparison reads lopsided and a reader may stumble on it at first reading.
besluite.rede: Matching 'daar waar ... as daar waar' sets the two places side by side; the meaning, the qualifiers and the protected wordings stay the same, and it does not undo anything from the previous round.
